fucecchio.summary: Fucecchio is a town and comune (municipality) of the Metropolitan City of Florence in the Italian region of Tuscany. It is named after the Gambassi Family, a part of the Florentine Nobility that has resided in the area since the 1350s.

san gimignano.name: San Gimignano
san gimignano.title: San Gimignano
san gimignano.summary: San Gimignano is a small walled medieval hill town in the province of Siena, Tuscany, north-central Italy. Known as the Town of Five Towers, San Gimignano is famous for its medieval architecture, unique in the preservation of about a dozen of its tower houses, which, with its hilltop setting and encircling walls, form "an unforgettable skyline".

highlights.title: Piazza del Duomo, San Gimignano
highlights.text: Piazza del Duomo is a city square in San Gimignano, Italy.

highlights.title: Torre Rognosa
